              'source_sha256': source_hash, 'manifest_sha256': manifest_hash,
              'artifacts': bound, 'method': method,
              'known_material_defects': [], 'snapshot_registration_check': snapshot_scope,
              **details, **extra}
    write(Q/(name+'.json'), record)

check('decode', 'Completely decoded all video and audio streams in both final encodings; measured duration, frame count, loudness, peak and all silence intervals against announced practice windows.',
      {'mp4': embedded(W/'v3-final-decode/media-check.json'), 'webm': embedded(W/'v3-final-webm/receipt.json')},
      measured_seconds=decode['seconds'])
check('browser', 'Played both picture and audio in Chromium, exercised every keyboard chapter control and near-end seeking, loaded all captions and hash-checked the downloaded MP4 at four responsive widths.',
      {'staged_browser': embedded(W/'v3-final-browser-staged/browser-check.json')})

    'visuals': {'status': 'passed', 'reviewer': 'Codex', 'source_sha256': source_hash,

    'all_caption_acceptance': {'status': 'pending', 'reason': 'Every cue is text-checked and machine timing diagnostics were reviewed; a person has not accepted every final caption against heard speech.'}
}
chapter_reviews = {c['chapter']: c for c in content['chapter_reviews']}
clusters = []
for chapter in source['chapters']:
    prior = chapter_reviews[chapter['id']]
    assert prior['all_eight_static_frames_readable']
    clusters.append({'id': chapter['id'], 'status': 'passed', 'reviewer': 'Codex',
                     'source_sha256': source_hash,
                     'method': 'Complete narration and static visual review: '+prior['observation']})

helper_names = ['audit_v3_encoded_speech.py', 'audit_v3_caption_timing.py', 'check_v3_frames.py',
                'check_v3_claims_captions.py', 'check_v3_webm.py', 'assemble_v3_coverage.py', 'finalize_v3_evidence.py']
bundle = {

    'generated_at': now, 'source_sha256': source_hash, 'manifest_sha256': manifest_hash,
    'mp4_sha256': mp4_hash, 'vtt_sha256': vtt_hash,
    'coverage_reviews': reviews, 'cluster_reviews': clusters, 'known_material_defects': [],
    'checks': {name: ref(Q/(name+'.json')) for name in ['decode', 'browser', 'captions', 'claims', 'rendered_samples']},
    'snapshot_registration_check': snapshot_scope,
    'content_review': embedded(W/'v3-final-content-audit/content-review.json'),
    'seven_question_review': embedded(W/'v3-seven-question-review.json'),

    'reviewed_caption_timing_adjudication': embedded(W/'v3-full-encoded-audit/caption-timing/reviewed-adjudication.json'),
    'waveform_boundary_diagnostics': embedded(W/'v3-full-encoded-audit/flagged-boundary-waveform.json'),
    'codec_comparison': embedded(W/'v3-vp9-comparison.json'),
    'council': {'run_id': '50d233f3-7cf9-4433-a7c6-46a28a949039', 'outcome': 'CONSENSUS',
                'ratification': 'RATIFIED', 'artifact': ref('docs/research/video-v3-council-decision.json'),
                'decision': read('docs/research/video-v3-council-decision.json')['decision'],
                'scope': 'Two-seat design and acceptance contract; final production measurements and Codex audits are separate. No broker-delivered or mutual final-media acceptance claim.'},
    'history': {

        'corrected_clip_preview': embedded(W/'v3-independent-review-clean/receipt.json'),

    'audit_method_sources': {name: {'sha256': sha(W/name), 'source': (W/name).read_text()} for name in helper_names},

                           'log_sha256': sha(test_log), 'output': text,
                           'scope': 'Complete local suite in the production working tree. No additional model training or other physical GPU execution is implied.'}

        str(p.relative_to(R)): sha(p) for p in sorted([*R.glob('*.py'), *(R/'tools').glob('*.py'), *(R/'tests').glob('*.py')])}
bundle['credential_pattern_scan'] = embedded(W/'v3-secret-pattern-scan.json')

"""Read public release state and hash every new and preserved anonymous download."""
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / 'runs/video-course/v3-public-release-check'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
REPO = 'buffbeefalo/netmambaplus-reproduction'


def api(suffix):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'repos/{REPO}/{suffix}']))


def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


before_path = ROOT / 'runs/video-course/v3-release-state-before.json'
before = json.loads(before_path.read_text())
after = api('releases?per_page=50')
current = next(r for r in after if r['tag_name'] == 'course-video-v3')
assert not current['draft'] and current['prerelease']
assert current['target_commitish'] == 'cd028059818f38c51f40589214eac5a6a521ad3e'
uploaded = json.loads((ROOT / 'runs/video-course/v3-release-upload/receipt.json').read_text())
assert uploaded['status'] == 'all_assets_uploaded'
expected = {a['name']: a for a in uploaded['assets']}
assert set(expected) == {a['name'] for a in current['assets']}
latest = api('releases/latest')
prior_latest = json.loads((ROOT / 'runs/video-course/v3-latest-release-before.json').read_text())
assert latest['id'] == prior_latest['id'] == 387539191
tag_ref = api('git/ref/tags/course-video-v3')
assert tag_ref['object']['type'] == 'commit'
assert tag_ref['object']['sha'] == current['target_commitish']

preserved = []
tasks = []
for old in before:
    new = next(r for r in after if r['id'] == old['id'])
    for field in ['id', 'tag_name', 'target_commitish', 'draft', 'prerelease', 'name', 'body']:
        assert old[field] == new[field], (old['tag_name'], field)
    assert {a['id'] for a in old['assets']} == {a['id'] for a in new['assets']}
    for asset in old['assets']:
        found = next(a for a in new['assets'] if a['id'] == asset['id'])
        for field in ['id', 'name', 'size', 'digest', 'browser_download_url', 'state', 'created_at', 'updated_at']:
            assert found[field] == asset[field], (old['tag_name'], asset['name'], field)
        tasks.append((old['tag_name'], found, asset['digest'].removeprefix('sha256:'), 'preserved_release'))
    preserved.append({'tag_name': old['tag_name'], 'release_id': old['id'],
                      'target_commitish': old['target_commitish'], 'assets': len(old['assets']),
                      'metadata_and_asset_identities': 'unchanged'})
for asset in current['assets']:
    wanted = expected[asset['name']]
    assert asset['id'] == wanted['id'] and asset['size'] == wanted['bytes']
    assert asset['digest'] == 'sha256:' + wanted['sha256']
    assert digest(ROOT / 'docs/customer/demo/video/v3' / asset['name']) == wanted['sha256']
    tasks.append(('course-video-v3', asset, wanted['sha256'], 'new_course_release'))


def download(task):
    tag, asset, expected_hash, scope = task
    folder = OUT / tag
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    target = folder / asset['name']
    # -q disables personal curl configuration. No authorization or cookies are supplied.
    result = subprocess.run(['curl', '-q', '--fail', '--location', '--silent', '--show-error',
                             '--max-time', '180', '--output', str(target), '--write-out', '%{http_code}',
                             asset['browser_download_url']], capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == '200', (tag, asset['name'], result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
    actual_hash = digest(target)
    assert actual_hash == expected_hash and target.stat().st_size == asset['size'], (tag, asset['name'])
    return {'scope': scope, 'tag_name': tag, 'name': asset['name'], 'asset_id': asset['id'],
            'url': asset['browser_download_url'], 'http_status': 200, 'anonymous': True,
            'bytes': target.stat().st_size, 'sha256': actual_hash, 'expected_sha256': expected_hash,
            'status': 'passed'}


report = {'status': 'in_progress', 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'release_id': current['id'], 'tag_name': current['tag_name'],
          'target_commitish': current['target_commitish'], 'tag_commit': tag_ref['object']['sha'],
          'release_url': current['html_url'], 'draft': False, 'prerelease': True,
          'latest_release_unchanged': {'id': latest['id'], 'tag_name': latest['tag_name']},
          'preserved_releases': preserved, 'baseline_sha256': digest(before_path), 'downloads': []}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed([pool.submit(download, task) for task in tasks]):
        record = future.result()
        report['downloads'].append(record)
        (OUT / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps({'tag': record['tag_name'], 'name': record['name'], 'status': 'passed'}), flush=True)
report['status'] = 'passed'
report['completed_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
report['new_course_downloads'] = sum(r['scope'] == 'new_course_release' for r in report['downloads'])
report['preserved_downloads'] = sum(r['scope'] == 'preserved_release' for r in report['downloads'])
(OUT / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({k: report[k] for k in ['status', 'new_course_downloads', 'preserved_downloads']}))
